title: United States state choropleth
intent: Compare values across actual United States state and district boundaries.

ai.create: Create a 51-feature United States choropleth from us-atlas TopoJSON using the same responsive Albers USA projection and literal state fills in Observable Plot and TanStack geoShape.
ai.maintain: Preserve actual atlas boundaries, stable FIPS keys, the 50 states plus District of Columbia, Alaska and Hawaii insets, revision-driven fills, and one projected path per feature.
